changelog:
# CHANGELOG for firmware release v118 — target esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi connection loss
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected error in handling of incoming MQTT messages

## 🔐 Security
* Identified and documented one potential secret in the codebase
* Confirmed zero critical CVEs affecting the current release
* Noted a security score of 0/10, indicating significant room for improvement

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, currently at 43.9% capacity
* Identified potential savings of 95 KB in flash storage
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated four new tests to enhance code coverage and validation
* Applied zero AI patches in this release, focusing on manual review and testing
* Maintained a build success rate, ensuring reliable compilation and deployment

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Passed build process with no errors or warnings
* Confirmed compliance with esp-idf framework guidelines and best practices
* Validated device functionality and performance under various test scenarios

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* Security score of 0/10 indicates a high risk of security vulnerabilities
* Presence of one potential secret in the codebase poses a risk to device security
* Limited testing and validation of certain device features and protocols

## 🔜 Next Release
* Prioritize addressing security concerns and improving the security score
* Apply AI patches and automated testing to enhance code quality and reliability
* Focus on reducing flash usage and optimizing device performance for improved user experience
